m5C Site Atlas

The final 2,416 m5C sites called by sRNA-TAPS in miRNA, tRNA, rRNA and snoRNA of canonical annotated genes. Each site passed replicate-level testing against the untreated control (posterior probability ≥ 0.95 and median rate difference ≥ 0.10, six replicates per cell line). Rate and coverage are pooled over the cell lines in which the site was called. A further 321 miRNA sites are labelled as the Figs. 4 to 6 set. These are in a mature arm and meet a per-site rule (rate ≥ 20%, p < 0.05 and coverage ≥ 5 in at least one replicate) but not the final criteria, and their rate and coverage are pooled over all 12 treatment replicates. Sites are cross-referenced against the literature where that comparison has been built. Click any row to open its full sequence, structure and literature support.

Status definitions

How each row's literature status is assigned
reported

Literature position independently reproduced in this study's final calls.

novel

Called here at a mature miRNA position with no literature record found.

not assessed

No literature cross-reference built for this site (rRNA, snoRNA, other mt-tRNA positions and miRNA precursor sites). This is not a claim that the site is unreported.
